title: Scaled noise operator norm bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0<\delta\leq 1$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube $\{\pm1\}^n$. Applying the noise operator with parameter $(1-\delta)/\sqrt{3}$ gives $\|T_{(1-\delta)/\sqrt{3}}f\|_4\leq \delta^{-1}\|f\|_2$, where the norms are taken with respect to the uniform measure on the cube.
